title: Fenton Cross-Paper Arbiter
description: Multi-agent Fenton mining, step 5B (the cross-paper supplement to verification): grades every candidate contradiction A/B/C/D/E (E = other, unclassifiable, also the fallback for undecidable cases), settles the adopted value, and judges cross-paper conflicts (cross_paper) and definitional differences (caliber_variance), returning a JSON adjudication that the main agent writes to _ledgers/adjudication.json. It is the only body in the pipeline with authority to grade a contradiction, because cross-paper conflicts are invisible inside a single paper and grading must use one uniform standard. The criteria table, output schema, and merge keys are inlined in system.md with no skills attached; graph_query supplies cross-paper leads from already-ingested conclusions. Read-only; the main agent writes.
